vectors.title: Server stream behind login-shell noise
First connection: HELLO, WELCOME, then SUB ev and SNAP(new) with backlog
No common protocol version: BYE E_VERSION, client falls back to Stage A
Client 1..2, daemon 1..1: WELCOME proto 1, features = intersection
Durable ev item and the client's ACK
Reconnect over another transport, position inside the ring: exact replay
Position older than the ring: SNAP(overflow) + backlog
Daemon restarted (new epoch): SNAP(epoch) with the seeded backlog
Session table: SNAP with the full table, then a diff
Transcript watch from an offset: one delta up to the last complete line
Transcript shorter than the client's offset: reset delta
Terminal subscribe from the active device; raw PTY bytes
Output dropped under backpressure: tseq jump + redraw
Only the owner sizes the window; IN without a term SUB does not take ownership; TSTATE goes to all
Parked input with server pacing; the retransmit after reconnect is a dup with the original result
Intent persisted, daemon died before tmux confirmed: unknown; a gap is refused and consumes nothing
rpc exec: allowed tag and verbs, complete result
rpc exec output in pieces: RPCPART frames, then RPCRES
rpc exec refused: text:kill-server
rpc exec refused: tag:debug.shell
rpc exec refused: tmux-verb:new
rpc exec refused: text:new-session
rpc exec refused: tmux-verb:set
Liveness, and a newer HELLO of the same (dev, link) supersedes the old connection
A transcript line larger than maxFrame: TX pieces with more:true
An adjusted read that yields nothing keeps reset pending until the next delta
Resume against an empty ring: `last` is the counter, the backlog ignores age
Daemon start: seed the ring with the last 25 lines of each source, then follow from EOF
A paused connection whose next item left the ring gets SNAP(overflow) in the middle of the connection
ACK right after resume is legal; an ACK with another ep is ignored; above what was sent is E_PROTO
Same device, two serverIds (LAN entry and CF entry) to one host: two connections, no supersede
A delayed HELLO with a lower attempt number is refused STALE and does not touch the live connection
A permanent refusal consumes its iseq; a transient one does not; a dup reports the original result
A reused iseq with a different payload is E_IN_CONFLICT, never a silent dup
A gap the client cannot fill: INSKIP moves hi without typing anything
The daemon's input state is not the one the client talked to: rotate `ie`, never resend
Delivery plans: multi-line text and a trailing ';' go through paste-buffer; broken UTF-8 is refused
deny_scan negative table: every bypass the critiques found is refused
deny_scan positive table: the tagged sites' real command shapes pass
rpc exec failures: E_TIMEOUT, E_BUSY, E_OUTPUT
Canonical header JSON: UTF-8 raw, U+2028 and <>& raw, only quote, backslash and C0 escaped
Socket unusable: TSTATE refused; tmux server replaced: server-changed and SNAP(tmux-restart), never mass `gone`
Foreground/background change mid-connection: STATE{fg, pingMs}
crd.off appears: BYE E_OFF on every live connection; daemon stop: BYE E_SHUTDOWN with retryMs
maxFrame below 65536 is refused at the handshake
Length field above maxFrame
Reserved flag bits set
Unknown type below 0x80
Unknown type in the extension range 0x80..0xFF is skipped
No magic within 64 KiB (crd missing: shell printed 'command not found')
EV without seq
A server-to-client type (TX) in the client's stream
PING with the blob flag and bytes
EV with seq as a string
Client stream whose first frame is not HELLO
